title: Department of Defense Secure Access File Exchange Modernization
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEFENSE INFORMATION SYSTEMS AGENCY (DISA) > DEFENSE INFORMATION SYSTEMS AGENCY
description:
The Government previously published an RFI to SAM.gov on December 17, 2025, under Tracking Number 622673683. The Government’s required capabilities have evolved since that time, and the Government is looking for updated industry responses. 

  

 Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), P ortfolio Acquisition Executive Command, Control, Communications & Enterprise / Services Division (PAE C3E/ SD), is modernizing a large file transfer system. The modernized solution will update the Department of War’s (DoW) Secure Access File Exchange (SAFE). SAFE is a DoW Common Access Card (CAC)-enabled, DISA enterprise secure file exchange platform hosted on Non-classified Internet Protocol Router Network that is also accessible via the Secret Internet Protocol Router Network.
